source_cv: original person folds 0..4; train on four folds and validate on the remaining fold in every source domain
source_selection: mean of per-domain mean five-fold AUROC; single-class folds have no AUROC and are excluded; exact ties choose smaller C
weighting: domain-prefixed person IDs; inverse person origin count; equal domain base mass; then global class balance and training-prior logit correction
final_fit: all source rows only; store source config, CV trials, OOF predictions and model before any target inference

target_endpoints.CARE-v6: official industrial fault event_end in [issue+1d,issue+8d); separate native disruption endpoint
target_endpoints.TOLIFE-CSA: fixed daily future persistent fluctuation; prepared train/validation identities only

dnb: native score_window on past32 selected normalized states, minimum12; higher is risk; no calibration or direction selection
bootstrap: resample complete assets for CARE and complete people for human cohorts; percentile95 intervals
within_cluster_auroc: equal-weight mean AUROC over clusters containing both classes; bootstrap uses the same cluster multiplicities
auprc: average precision on the native probability/score ordering
